method: Orient angle d=(target geocentric longitude - aspector longitude) mod 360. Let within_sign_degrees = d mod 30. Output strength in 0..60 virupas. Distinct general aspect function lives in B38, and B39 applies only planet-specific overrides.

numerical_issues.interpretation: Direct Sanskrit 26.12 plus ordinary B38 fallback as written yields an abrupt positive discontinuity. Record it; do not automatically smooth source wording.

numerical_issues.issue: Describes half a degree in third house and 45 in seventh, while the Sanskrit compounds bhagardham sharavedayuk for three/seven together, consistent with half the local degrees plus 45 in both.
Sanskrit catur-ashtabhe, 4 and 8 full-sign offsets (120–150 and 240–270) require precise ordinal sign difference convention. Do not recast as fourth/eighth counted-from-one houses without mapping.
